content: Hierarchical neural network models BIBREF22 , BIBREF23 have been applied to RST-style discourse parsing BIBREF24 mainly for the purpose of generating text-level hierarchical discourse structures. In contrast, we use hierarchical neural network models to build context-aware sentence representations in order to improve implicit discourse relation prediction.
